title: How Do I Deal With My Team Members Who Are Resisting Change?
summary_bullets: Andi Roberts explores how to handle team members who resist change.
Argues that labeling resistant employees as 'difficult' is usually the wrong diagnosis.
Focuses on understanding root causes of resistance rather than surface behavior.

title: Code Yellow, Code Red
summary_bullets: James Stanier explains the origin and meaning of 'Code Yellow' and 'Code Red' incident designations.
Shares how these escalation levels were run at Provet, including structure and lessons learned.
Offers a generalized template and guidance on when to declare or escalate an incident.

title: What Does "Playing Politics" Mean For Software Engineers?
summary_bullets: Sean Goedecke reframes 'playing politics' as understanding how a company actually operates.
Argues it's about identifying who holds power and what behaviors get rewarded.
Suggests aligning with powerful stakeholders rather than scheming or manipulation.

title: Reverse Engineering ChatGPT Web: How OpenAI Built for a Billion Users
summary_bullets: Dennis Brotzky reverse engineers the ChatGPT web app to understand its architecture.
Digs through page source, bundled code, and network requests for insights.
Reveals the complexity behind what looks like a simple chat interface.

title: Benford's Law: The Strange Law That Catches Financial Fraudsters
summary_bullets: Vatsal Bakshi explains Benford's Law and its unexpected digit distribution in real-world data.
The digit 1 appears as a leading digit about 30% of the time, far more than expected.
Highlights how this statistical quirk helps detect financial fraud.

title: Using Local Coding Agents
summary_bullets: Sebastian Raschka provides a tutorial for building a production-ready local coding agent.
Uses a locally served LLM combined with a local coding harness.
Covers reading files, making edits, running commands, and verifying changes.

title: Quadrupling Code Performance With A "Useless" If
summary_bullets: Alisa Sireneva demonstrates how an apparently redundant 'if' statement can boost performance.
Explains how branch prediction can turn a latency-bound loop into a throughput-bound one.
Shows a real-world example of micro-optimization yielding a 4x speedup.

title: 5 Things World-Class Engineers Do That You Don't
summary_bullets: Steve Huynh identifies habits that distinguish world-class engineers.
Was the most popular article from the previous newsletter issue.
Focuses on practical behaviors readers can adopt.

title: Loopy
summary_bullets: A tool for practical AI-agent loops.
Listed under Notable Links as a resource for building agent workflows.

title: Monitor
summary_bullets: A Claude Code usage monitor with predictions and warnings.
Helps track and forecast usage for Claude-based coding tools.

title: OpenKnowledge
summary_bullets: An open-source AI-native markdown IDE and LLM wiki.
Combines note-taking with AI-powered knowledge management.

title: Tau
summary_bullets: A minimalist agent designed to teach users how to build coding agents.
Serves as an educational tool for understanding agent architecture.

title: Termcn
summary_bullets: A collection of terminal UI components for developers.
Useful for building command-line interfaces and tools.
